Basic text-to-speech generation

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.speech(LiterLlm::CreateSpeechRequest.new(input: 'Hello, world!', model: 'tts-1', voice: 'alloy'))
puts result.audio.inspect
```
